detail.title: Roar 700 | 4.1 Multimedia Speaker (Bluetooth, USB, TF card, AUX, & FM)
detail.overview: Experience high-fidelity sound with the Intex Roar 700, featuring a powerful 70W output for crystal-clear audio. With multiple playback options including Bluetooth, USB, TF card, AUX, and FM, you can enjoy your favorite music in any way you like. The informative LED display and digital controls make navigation simple, while the fully functional IR remote adds extra convenience. Designed for portability, it offers a 10-meter Bluetooth range and premium sound effects, making it perfect for any setting.
features: Powerful 70W sound output for an immersive audio experience
Multimode playability: Bluetooth, USB, TF Card, AUX, and FM
Fully functional IR remote for easy control
Digital control enabled for seamless navigation
Informative LED display for clear status updates
Portable design with a 10-meter Bluetooth range
High-performance 10.16 cm (4-inch) woofer for deep bass
Premium sound effects for rich and clear audio
